title: When May an Agent Stop? Evidence-Carrying Termination for Tool-Using LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.23623v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-using agents must decide when to stop. Existing systems already gate terminal success, certify execution traces, or enforce runtime polici es, but do not test this particular receipt-, scope-, and closed-replay design at the COMPLETE boundary across controlled termination faults. W e instantiate and evaluate Evidence-Carrying Termination (ECT): an agent may return COMPLETE only when a typed certificate binds every required answer claim to valid, in-scope trace evidence and a deterministic replay reconstructs the claimed value. A locked static study crosses 48 ful ly synthetic tasks in six tool-use families with clean execution and eight faults. ECT produced 0/288 unsafe completions versus 252/288 for the inspected termination-critic core (difference -87.50 pp, 95% task-cluster interval [-87.50, -87.50] pp). translated_title: 智能体何时可以停止？面向工具使用大语言模型的证据携带式终止机制
translated_abstract: 使用工具的智能体必须决定何时停止。现有系统已经能够对最终成功进行门控、认证执行轨迹或执行运行时策略，但在受控终止故障的完整边界上，并未测试这种特定的收据-范围-闭环重放设计。我们实例化并评估了证据携带式终止（ECT）：仅当类型化证书将每个所需答案声明绑定到有效、范围内的轨迹证据，且确定性重放能重建所声称的值时，智能体才可返回COMPLETE。一项锁定的静态研究跨越六个工具使用家族的48个完全合成任务，涵盖干净执行和八种故障。ECT产生了0/288次不安全完成，而检查过的终止评论核心为252/288次（差异-87.50个百分点，95%任务簇区间[-87.50, -87.50]个百分点）。随后，一项全新、预先指定且冻结的576轨迹研究将ECT与评论核心、其忠实控制器及另一方法进行了比较。
tldr: 本文提出证据携带式终止机制，通过类型化证书和确定性重放确保工具使用大语言模型仅在安全时返回完成，在受控故障下实现零不安全完成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Evidence-Carrying Termination, which uses typed certificates and deterministic replay to ensure tool-using LLMs only return completion when safe, achieving zero unsafe completions under controlled faults.
